# Matheus Hoffmann (h0ffmann)

> Staff software engineer and forward deployed engineer in Florianópolis, Brazil. He runs Piabrota AI Studio, leads the marola open-source organization, and ports the WAVEWATCH III ocean wave model to GPUs at UFSC. This repository, piabrota/nix-os, is the NixOS configuration of the servers of Piabrota.

This file is an index of all his public work, for language models and for persons. It follows https://llmstxt.org and it is in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Each link has one short note; the detail is behind the link. When this file and a linked repository do not agree, the repository is correct. The facts come from h0ffmann/h0ffmann (its llms.txt and `site/data/works.tsv` at commit 80504b5, 2026-11-10) and from `mockups/data.nix` of this repository.

For Piabrota only, read the index of the site: https://www.piabrota.art/llms.txt. The build makes it from `mockups/data.nix`, so it lists every service, project and fork of Piabrota.

## Research: wave models at UFSC

- [ww3-gpu](https://github.com/h0ffmann/ww3-gpu): a port of WAVEWATCH III (WW3) from Fortran to C++ with Kokkos and CUDA. The goal: WW3 runs faster on GPUs and gives the same results as the Fortran, bit for bit.
- [ww3-dia-gpu-v2](https://github.com/h0ffmann/ww3-dia-gpu-v2): the whole W3SNL1 routine, inside WW3, bit for bit.
- [chaceon](https://github.com/h0ffmann/chaceon): CPU and GPU wave modelling in Rust.
- [marola-bench](https://marola-dev.github.io/marola-research/marola-bench/): a proposal for a weather benchmark for Brazil, scored against buoys.
- [ondaseventos.ufsc.br](https://ondaseventos.ufsc.br): the research team, 5 persons. The research continues until mid-2027.

## marola: open-source water app

- [marola.dev](https://marola.dev): the live map. It shows the best hour to swim at beaches in Brazil, with the bathing-water quality.
- [marola-dev organization](https://github.com/marola-dev): 12 public repositories (9 November 2026).
- [marola](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola): the umbrella repository. It holds the design proposals (MIPs) and the ways of working.
- [marola-app](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola-app): the backend.
- [marola-site](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola-site): the frontend of marola.dev.
- [marola-ml](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola-ml): the fine-tuned model, the DSPy prompt compile and the benchmark gate.
- [marola-devkit](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola-devkit): the development harness: scripts, a Claude Code plugin marketplace and reusable workflows.
- [marola-research](https://github.com/marola-dev/marola-research): the research of the project.

## Piabrota AI Studio (since October 2026)

- [www.piabrota.art](https://www.piabrota.art/): the site of the studio: the projects, the structure, the dogma and the forks.
- [Index of the site for AI agents](https://www.piabrota.art/llms.txt): every service, project and fork of Piabrota.
- [piabrota on GitHub](https://github.com/piabrota): the organization, with every repository.
- [nix-os](https://github.com/piabrota/nix-os): this repository. The NixOS configuration of the two VPSs that serve piabrota.art.
- [mu](https://github.com/piabrota/mu): the company chart: the dogma, the standards, the journal and the index of the repositories.
- [pirsig](https://github.com/piabrota/pirsig): a second brain in Rust: PARA and a Zettelkasten slip-box. Desktop app, REST API and the psg CLI.
- [gramatico](https://github.com/piabrota/gramatico): a Claude Code plugin that rewrites technical text in Brazilian Portuguese.
- [room.piabrota.art](https://room.piabrota.art/): a 3D room with camera shots, a VCR and a radio.
- [metrics.piabrota.art](https://metrics.piabrota.art/): processes, memory and vCPU of the two hosts.
- [hermes.piabrota.art](https://hermes.piabrota.art/): the dashboard of Hermes, his personal agent. Behind a login.
- [rig.piabrota.art](https://rig.piabrota.art/): the OpenRig UI, the engine of the software factory. Behind a login.

## Ouroboric

- [ouroboric-dev](https://github.com/ouroboric-dev): open factories that improve themselves. The charter, the standards, the journal and the brand.

## Books and other works

- [closed-source](https://h0ffmann.github.io/closed-source/): a book on why closed source failed as a protection, and on the ethics of citation.
- [nashkell](https://h0ffmann.github.io/nashkell/): an open book in progress on game theory, in Haskell.
- [picasso](https://github.com/h0ffmann/picasso): Nix flakes that pin the toolchains of the other works. Deterministic toolchains with just, Nix and Rust.
- [proof](https://github.com/h0ffmann/proof): specifications in Lean 4, with Haskell and Rust implementations that are checked against them. Its pages are at https://proof.piabrota.art/.
